review.method: Visual review with local Whisper transcript support

steps.title: Fold the paper
steps.instruction: Fold ten A4 paper sheets in half.

steps.title: Cut the folded sheets
steps.instruction: Cut each sheet along its fold.

steps.title: Assemble the pages
steps.instruction: Stack the pages between the front and back covers.

steps.title: Make the spine holes
steps.instruction: Mark two spine holes and pierce them with a thumb tack.

steps.title: Thread the fasteners
steps.instruction: Straighten two paper clips and thread one through each hole.

steps.title: Secure the spine
steps.instruction: Twist each wire end tightly and fold it against the spine.
